items.source: At the low-level, RedisConnection offers the subscribe and pSubscribe methods that map the Redis commands for subscribing by channel or by pattern, respectively. Note that multiple channels or patterns can be used as arguments. To change the subscription of a connection or query whether it is listening, RedisConnection provides the getSubscription and isSubscribed methods.
items.translation: 在底层，RedisConnection 提供了 subscribe 和 pSubscribe 方法，分别对应通过频道或模式订阅的 Redis 命令。请注意，这些方法可以接受多个频道或模式作为参数。若要更改连接的订阅状态或查询其是否正在监听，RedisConnection 提供了 getSubscription 和 isSubscribed 方法。

items.source: Notice that, although the interface does not extend the MessageListener interface, it can still be used as a MDP by using the MessageListenerAdapter class. Notice also how the various message handling methods are strongly typed according to the contents of the various Message types that they can receive and handle. In addition, the channel or pattern to which a message is sent can be passed in to the method as the second argument of type String:
items.translation: 请注意，尽管该接口并未扩展 `MessageListener` 接口，但通过使用 `MessageListenerAdapter` 类，它仍然可以作为 MDP 使用。 此外，请注意各种消息处理方法是根据它们能够接收和处理的各个 `Message` 类型的内容进行强类型定义的。 另外，可以向方法传递消息发送的通道或模式作为第二个类型为 `String` 的参数：

items.source: As mentioned earlier, once subscribed, a connection starts waiting for messages. Only commands that add new subscriptions, modify existing subscriptions, and cancel existing subscriptions are allowed. Invoking anything other than subscribe, pSubscribe, unsubscribe, or pUnsubscribe throws an exception.
items.translation: 如前所述，订阅后连接将开始等待消息。 仅允许添加新订阅、修改现有订阅以及取消现有订阅的命令。 调用除subscribe、pSubscribe、unsubscribe或pUnsubscribe之外的任何内容都会抛出异常。

items.source: RedisMessageListenerContainer acts as a message listener container. It is used to receive messages from a Redis channel and drive the MessageListener instances that are injected into it. The listener container is responsible for all threading of message reception and dispatches into the listener for processing. A message listener container is the intermediary between an MDP and a messaging provider and takes care of registering to receive messages, resource acquisition and release, exception conversion, and the like. This lets you as an application developer write the (possibly complex) business logic associated with receiving a message (and reacting to it) and delegates boilerplate Redis infrastructure concerns to the framework.
items.translation: RedisMessageListenerContainer 充当消息监听容器。它用于从 Redis 频道接收消息，并驱动注入到其中的 MessageListener 实例。该监听容器负责消息接收的所有线程管理以及向监听器分发消息以供处理。消息监听容器是 MDP（消息驱动进程）与消息提供者之间的中介，负责注册接收消息、资源的获取与释放、异常转换等工作。这使得应用程序开发者可以专注于编写（可能复杂的）与接收消息（并对此做出反应）相关的业务逻辑，而将冗余的 Redis 基础设施关注点委托给框架处理。

items.source: A MessageListener can additionally implement SubscriptionListener to receive notifications upon subscription/unsubscribe confirmation. Listening to subscription notifications can be useful when synchronizing invocations.
items.translation: `MessageListener` 还可以实现 `SubscriptionListener`，以便在订阅/取消订阅确认时接收通知。监听订阅通知在同步调用时非常有用。

items.source: To await and ensure proper subscription, you can use the receiveLater method that returns a Mono<Flux<ChannelMessage>>. The resulting Mono completes with an inner publisher as a result of completing the subscription to the given topics. By intercepting onNext signals, you can synchronize server-side subscriptions.
items.translation: 要等待并确保正确订阅，您可以使用返回 `Mono<Flux<ChannelMessage>>` 的 `receiveLater` 方法。 由于已订阅给定主题，生成的 `Mono` 将完成并包含一个内部发布器。 通过拦截 `onNext` 信号，您可以同步服务器端的订阅。

items.source: As mentioned above you can directly use ReactiveRedisTemplate to subscribe to channels / patterns. This approach offers a straight forward, though limited solution as you lose the option to add subscriptions after the initial ones. Nevertheless you still can control the message stream via the returned Flux using eg. take(Duration). When done reading, on error or cancellation all bound resources are freed again.
items.translation: 如上所述，您可以直接使用ReactiveRedisTemplate来订阅频道或模式。这种方法提供了一种简单但有限的解决方案，因为您无法在初始订阅之后添加新的订阅。尽管如此，您仍然可以通过返回的Flux（例如使用take(Duration)）来控制消息流。读取完成、发生错误或取消操作时，所有绑定的资源都会被释放。

items.source: Furthermore, to minimize the application footprint, RedisMessageListenerContainer lets one connection and one thread be shared by multiple listeners even though they do not share a subscription. Thus, no matter how many listeners or channels an application tracks, the runtime cost remains the same throughout its lifetime. Moreover, the container allows runtime configuration changes so that you can add or remove listeners while an application is running without the need for a restart. Additionally, the container uses a lazy subscription approach, using a RedisConnection only when needed. If all the listeners are unsubscribed, cleanup is automatically performed, and the thread is released.
items.translation: 此外，为最小化应用占用空间，RedisMessageListenerContainer 允许多个监听器共享一个连接和一个线程，即使它们不共享订阅关系。因此，无论应用程序跟踪多少监听器或通道，其运行成本在整个生命周期中保持不变。此外，容器支持运行时配置更改，使您能够在应用程序运行时添加或删除监听器，而无需重启应用。另外，该容器采用懒订阅方式，仅在需要时才使用 RedisConnection。如果所有监听器都已取消订阅，将自动执行清理操作并释放线程。

items.source: To help with the asynchronous nature of messages, the container requires a java.util.concurrent.Executor (or Spring’s TaskExecutor) for dispatching the messages. Depending on the load, the number of listeners, or the runtime environment, you should change or tweak the executor to better serve your needs. In particular, in managed environments (such as app servers), it is highly recommended to pick a proper TaskExecutor to take advantage of its runtime.
items.translation:
为了应对消息的异步特性，容器需要一个 `java.util.concurrent.Executor`（或 Spring 的 `TaskExecutor`）来分发这些消息。  
根据负载情况、监听器数量或运行环境的不同，您应该调整或优化该执行器，以更好地满足您的需求。  
特别是在托管环境（如应用服务器）中，强烈建议选择适当的 `TaskExecutor`，以便充分利用其运行时特性。

items.source: The MessageListenerAdapter class is the final component in Spring’s asynchronous messaging support. In a nutshell, it lets you expose almost any class as a MDP (though there are some constraints).
items.translation: `MessageListenerAdapter` 类是 Spring 异步消息支持中的最终组件。简而言之，它允许您将几乎任何类暴露为 MDP（尽管存在一些限制）。

items.source: In order to subscribe to messages, one needs to implement the MessageListener callback. Each time a new message arrives, the callback gets invoked and the user code gets run by the onMessage method. The interface gives access not only to the actual message but also to the channel it has been received through and the pattern (if any) used by the subscription to match the channel. This information lets the callee differentiate between various messages not just by content but also examining additional details.
items.translation: 要订阅消息，需要实现 `MessageListener` 回调接口。每当有新消息到达时，该回调就会被调用，并通过 `onMessage` 方法执行用户代码。此接口不仅提供对实际消息的访问，还提供接收消息的通道以及订阅用于匹配该通道的模式（如果有）。这些信息使得调用方不仅能根据内容区分不同的消息，还能通过检查其他详细信息来进行判断。

items.source: Due to its blocking nature, low-level subscription is not attractive, as it requires connection and thread management for every single listener. To alleviate this problem, Spring Data offers RedisMessageListenerContainer, which does all the heavy lifting. If you are familiar with EJB and JMS, you should find the concepts familiar, as it is designed to be as close as possible to the support in Spring Framework and its message-driven POJOs (MDPs).
items.translation: 由于其阻塞特性，低级订阅并不吸引人，因为每个监听器都需要进行连接和线程管理。 为缓解这一问题，Spring Data 提供了 `RedisMessageListenerContainer`，它负责处理所有繁重的工作。 如果您熟悉 EJB 和 JMS，您会发现这些概念非常熟悉，因为该设计尽可能贴近 Spring Framework 的支持及其消息驱动 POJO（MDP）。

items.source: Spring Data offers ReactiveRedisMessageListenerContainer which does all the heavy lifting of conversion and subscription state management on behalf of the user.
items.translation: Spring Data 提供了 ReactiveRedisMessageListenerContainer，它负责为用户处理所有的转换和订阅状态管理繁重工作。

items.source: Each time a message is received, the adapter automatically and transparently performs translation (using the configured RedisSerializer) between the low-level format and the required object type. Any exception caused by the method invocation is caught and handled by the container (by default, exceptions get logged).
items.translation: 每次接收到消息时，适配器都会自动且透明地在低级格式与所需对象类型之间执行转换（使用配置的 RedisSerializer）。 方法调用引发的任何异常都会被容器捕获并处理（默认情况下，异常会被记录日志）。

items.source:
On the receiving side, one can subscribe to one or multiple channels either by naming them directly or by using pattern matching.
The latter approach is quite useful, as it not only lets multiple subscriptions be created with one command but can also listen on channels not yet created at subscription time (as long as they match the pattern).
items.translation: 在接收端，用户可以通过直接命名或采用模式匹配的方式订阅一个或多个频道。后一种方法非常实用，因为它不仅允许通过一条命令创建多个订阅，还可以监听在订阅时尚未创建的频道（只要它们符合指定的模式）。

It uses the driver threads to publish messages.

items.source: Subscription commands in Spring Data Redis are blocking. That is, calling subscribe on a connection causes the current thread to block as it starts waiting for messages. The thread is released only if the subscription is canceled, which happens when another thread invokes unsubscribe or pUnsubscribe on the same connection. See “Message Listener Containers” (later in this document) for a solution to this problem.
items.translation: Spring Data Redis 中的订阅命令是阻塞的。也就是说，在连接上调用 subscribe 会导致当前线程阻塞，因为它开始等待消息。只有当订阅被取消时，该线程才会被释放，而这种情况发生在另一个线程对相同的连接调用了 unsubscribe 或 pUnsubscribe 时。有关此问题的解决方案，请参阅本文档稍后部分的“消息监听器容器”。

items.source: The listener topic can be either a channel (for example, topic="chatroom" respective Topic.channel("chatroom")) or a pattern (for example, topic="*room" respective Topic.pattern("*room")).
items.translation: 监听器主题可以是频道（例如 topic="chatroom" 对应 Topic.channel("chatroom")）或模式（例如 topic="*room" 对应 Topic.pattern("*room")）。
